description: Authentication system with NextAuth.js v5, role-based access control, mock user data, login page, and tRPC context. Implements credentials provider with mock users (admin, supervisor, engineer, reviewer, viewer roles), JWT session strategy, protected route middleware, and the auth-related tRPC procedures. Login page follows the design system.
steps: Create src/lib/mock-data/users.ts: Mock user data array with 5+ users covering all roles (admin, supervisor, engineer, reviewer, viewer). Each user has: id (UUID), username, email, password (plaintext for mock - 'password123'), name, designation, department, section, employeeId, phone, role, isActive, lastLogin. Use realistic Indian Railways designations (CWE, Sr.SDE, SSE, JE, etc.)

Create src/lib/auth/auth-options.ts: NextAuth.js v5 configuration with CredentialsProvider. Validates against mock users array. Returns user object with id, name, email, role, department, designation. JWT strategy with 15min access token simulation. Callbacks: jwt (adds role, userId to token), session (exposes role, userId to session)
Create src/lib/auth/index.ts: Export auth handlers, signIn, signOut, auth() session getter using NextAuth v5 API
Create src/middleware.ts: Next.js middleware that protects all routes under (protected) group. Redirects unauthenticated users to /login. Allows /login, /api/auth/* without auth

Create src/lib/auth/permissions.ts: Role-permission matrix as defined in Product Spec Section 7. Export hasPermission(role, action) function. Actions: view_documents, search, download, upload, create_work_records, create_pl, edit_bom, approve_documents, verify_work, manage_cases, manage_users, system_settings, view_audit

Build the login page at src/app/login/page.tsx: Clean login form following design system. Card centered on page, LDO-2 EDMS branding with orange accent, username + password inputs (30px height), 'Sign In' primary button, error message display, loading state. Dark/light theme aware

Create src/server/trpc.ts: tRPC initialization with context (session from NextAuth). Define publicProcedure, protectedProcedure (requires auth), engineerProcedure (requires engineer+), supervisorProcedure (requires supervisor+), adminProcedure (requires admin)
Create src/server/routers/_app.ts: Root tRPC router that merges sub-routers. Start with just auth router
Create src/server/routers/auth.ts: Auth router with procedures - getSession (returns current user), getProfile (returns full user profile from mock data)
Create src/app/api/trpc/[trpc]/route.ts: tRPC HTTP handler for Next.js App Router
Create src/lib/trpc/client.ts: tRPC client setup for client components (uses @trpc/react-query)
Create src/lib/trpc/server.ts: tRPC caller for server components
Create src/components/providers/trpc-provider.tsx: tRPC + QueryClient provider for client components
Update src/app/layout.tsx to wrap with TRPCProvider and QueryProvider
Create src/hooks/use-auth.ts: Custom hook returning session, user, role, hasPermission helper
Verify: 'npm run build' succeeds, 'npm run lint' passes
acceptance_criteria: Login page renders with username/password form following design system
Signing in with mock credentials (e.g., admin/password123) creates a session
Protected routes redirect to /login when not authenticated
tRPC context includes the authenticated user session
engineerProcedure rejects viewer/reviewer roles for write operations
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit 0
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm no errors
